title: Unified Compile-Time-Enforced UI Element State Model
description: Refactor every UI element (protocol UiNode layer in Rust/TS + entire ui-react design-system library) to share ONE compile-time-enforced state model: state: introducing | previewed | normal (default) | disabled | hidden; status: waiting | loading | idle (default) | finished (orthogonal, composable with state); hover: boolean; selected: boolean. When state=hidden everything else is ignored and the element is not rendered (no layout). All other combinations must be visually distinguishable via distinct channels. Folds in existing ad-hoc fields: disabled->state=disabled, pressed->selected, highlighted/highlighted_ids->state=previewed. hover is authored in the schema (default false) and OR'd with live pointer hover by renderers. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/ui-make-sure-that-robust-pizza.md covering: shared UiPresence/UiState/UiStatus Rust types embedded on all 19 UiNode variants + window/engagement/utility structs; exhaustive presence()/presence_mut() accessors for compile-time enforcement; migration of ~30 plugin crates' call sites; wgpu shared presence painter (KIND_FINISHED_BORDER, KIND_INTRODUCING_BORDER, centralized paint_node dispatch, hidden skips layout); ts-rs typegen closing the UiNode hand-mirror gap; TS/React shared UiElementStateProps + data-ui-state/data-ui-status/data-ui-hover/data-ui-selected attribute scheme in ui-styling + ui-react; a typed UI_ELEMENTS registry (~40 components) that fails to compile if a component's props don't declare all four axes, plus an anti-dodge test that every exported component is registered or explicitly exempted; CSS visual engine in ui.css; interpreter rewrite in framework/renderer/react; Storybook matrix story; test updates across Rust golden/wgpu paint tests, ui-styling unit tests, ui-react in-source matrix tests, framework-renderer-react tests.
summary:
Implemented the shared, compile-time-enforced UI element state model: state: introducing | previewed | normal (default) | disabled | hidden; status: waiting | loading | idle (default) | finished (orthogonal, composable); hover: boolean; selected: boolean. Hidden makes every other axis irrelevant (not rendered, no layout space).

RUST CORE (ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs): added UiState/UiStatus/UiPresence types (🔖Presence region) with helper constructors (state/status/selected/disabled_if/hidden_if, UiStatus::busy for old loading+waiting pairs). Embedded a mandatory `presence: UiPresence` field on all 19 UiNode variants (including the 10 that previously had zero state) plus UiControlNode/UiTreeItemNode/UiTreeSectionNode/UiTreeNode. Added exhaustive UiNode::presence()/presence_mut() accessors — the actual compile-time enforcement: a new variant now fails to compile until wired into both. Renamed UiTreeItemNode.is_hidden -> dimmed (a distinct domain concept: still-visible/dimmed/clickable "hidden in scene" eye-toggle, NOT presence.state==Hidden which means genuinely not rendered). Replaced UiTreeNode.selected_ids/highlighted_ids id-lists with per-item presence + a new ui_tree_stamp_presence() helper. Centralized the wgpu paint engine: presence_overlay() in paint_node draws status ring (loading spin/waiting dash/finished solid/idle none), selected outset ring, introducing pulse ring, and a disabled scrim, replacing ~10 duplicated per-widget dispatch sites. Added KIND_FINISHED_BORDER/KIND_INTRODUCING_BORDER WGSL kinds (raised-cosine breathing pulse for introducing). Hidden now skips layout entirely. cargo test -p ui_wgpu --features engine: 162/162 passing.

TYPEGEN (framework/core/rs/lib.rs): extended the ts-rs export list with UiPresence/UiState/UiStatus + 13 leaf UiNode variant structs + the Tree family + UiControlNode. 5 container structs deliberately NOT typegen'd yet — recursive through UiNode, blocked on a separate ComponentScene typegen follow-up.

TS/REACT: ui/styling/js/index.ts + index.test.ts — UI_STATES/UI_STATUSES/UiElementState/resolveElementState/elementStateAttributes (data-ui-state/data-ui-status/data-ui-hover/data-ui-selected, introducing converging on UIIntroduction's existing data-introduced)/ELEMENT_FILL_KINDS/resolveElementFillKind. 18/18 tests passing. ui/js/react/index.tsx — UiElementStateProps/useElementState contract in the 🐹Element region. Typecheck passes.

RUST PLUGIN/RENDERER MIGRATION (mechanical field-shape changes, behavior preserved): framework/plugin, cad/plugin, animate/plugin, forms/plugin, note/plugin, puzzle/plugin, architect/plugin, flow/plugin, gis/plugin, imperative/plugin, infinite/board/port/directed/dag/plugin, layout/plugin, lowpoly/plugin, raster/plugin, s/plugin, sequence/plugin, shooting/plugin, trinity/plugin, vcs/plugin, writer/plugin, draw/plugin, procedural/plugin, process/plugin, mathematical/plugin, sourcing/plugin, infinite/world/rs, protocol/rs, protocol/module/procedural/rs, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs.

Fixed all three; draw-plugin now compiles clean in isolation. Also cleared ~20GB of this session's own stale scratch `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`s under /tmp (semio-verify-*/semio-definitive-*/semio-check-*) that had filled the shared disk to 100% and were causing spurious "No space left on device" compile failures unrelated to any code. A fresh full-workspace check afterward is genuinely clean: the only remaining error anywhere in the workspace is the single pre-existing, unrelated E0753 doc-comment bug in framework/schema/rs/generated.rs (a different subsystem's generated file), already flagged separately via spawn_task, not part of this ticket.

Mid-session correction: 6 plugin-migration agents were mistakenly dispatched with isolation:"worktree", which this repo's CLAUDE.md explicitly forbids. Caught and corrected: every agent's file changes were extracted via plain `cp` into the shared main tree, re-verified there, and each worktree removed with `git worktree remove --force`. Saved as a feedback memory to prevent recurrence.

DELIBERATELY DEFERRED (documented, not silently dropped): (1) Window/Engagement/Utility layer (WindowMeasure, WindowEngagement*, UtilityNode) presence folding — host-shell chrome, not the declarative UiNode element tree. (2) Chrome introduction-tour visual unification — the new KIND_INTRODUCING_BORDER/UiState::Introducing primitive exists and is usable, but the existing tour system wasn't rewired to it since there is active concurrent development in that exact region (CLEAN-ELEMENT-ID-INTRODUCTION-SYSTEM ticket). (3) ComponentScene typegen (~15 nested scene types needing ts_rs derives). (4) Full ui-react component sweep (~40 components), the compile-time UI_ELEMENTS registry + anti-dodge test, the interpreter rewrite in framework/renderer/react/index.tsx, and Storybook stories — the shared contract is in place and typechecks, but migrating each component's markup needs real browser verification per component, a substantial remaining project.
